description: This file defines the MenuForm class for managing menu editing in Drupal, including form construction, validation, and submission handling for menu entities and their links.

classes.name: MenuForm
classes.description: Base form class for editing Drupal menus, handling form display, validation, and saving of menu entities and their links.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for menu link management, tree handling, link generation, and storage.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the menu edit form, including title, ID, description, language, and links overview.

methods.name: menuNameExists
methods.description: Checks if a menu name already exists or is in use.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the menu entity and redirects to the edit form.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, including overview form processing.

methods.name: buildOverviewForm
methods.description: Constructs a form section to display and manage menu links.

methods.name: buildOverviewTreeForm
methods.description: Recursively builds a tree of menu links for display and editing.

methods.name: submitOverviewForm
methods.description: Processes and saves changes to menu links, maintaining correct parent-child order.
